items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from torn hamstring; was listed Q.
items.why: Full practice week, starter reps, no setbacks.
items.implication: QB1 return; boosts CHI pass-catchers like Odunze, Moore, Loveland, Burden.
items.opportunity: Full snap share and red-zone opportunities restored for Bears skill players.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after high-ankle sprain IR stint.
items.why: Returned to practice this week; activated from IR.
items.implication: Immediate WR2/flex start if active; high volume expected with Maye.
items.opportunity: Primary target share boost; reduces role for others in NE WR room.

items.text: Eagles placing QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to blood clot after consultations with doctors; sidelines him indefinitely. Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Blood clot; multiple doctor consultations Saturday.
items.implication: Indefinite absence; McKee starts; Eagles pass-catchers and remaining RBs see full opportunity with backup QB.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Dontayvion Wicks; Dameon Pierce lead back.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday along with Will Shipley; Eagles RB room depleted with Hurts also out.
items.implication: Dameon Pierce likely lead back in thin PHI offense under McKee.
items.opportunity: All remaining PHI RB snaps/carries/red-zone to Pierce and whoever elevated; pass-game tilt possible.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB if available; will be better than expected. Not worried about any Eagles skill players with McKee. AJ Brown start if active as WR2.
items.why: McKee can play; top PHI pass-catchers healthy; AJB expected active.
items.implication: Stream McKee if desperate; start PHI WRs/TE and AJB confidently.
items.opportunity: PHI pass-catchers maintain roles under McKee; AJB target share.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf/Bernard. PHI McKee with 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce but top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon).
items.why: Practice reports and designations; PIT depth chart thinness; PHI personnel.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean start Metcalf/Olave/Caleb if active; PHI WRs viable with McKee; Warren risk.
items.opportunity: PIT 2-WR heavy Metcalf usage; PHI pass-catcher routes secure despite thin RB.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley or backup starts; downgrades BAL skill players volume/efficiency.
items.opportunity: Reduced rushing upside and overall offense; Flowers/Andrews/Henry see lower ceiling.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed OUT for Sunday.
items.implication: Increased targets for Worthy, Kelce, others in KC.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and Travis Kelce route/target share expansion.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Sunday.
items.implication: NYJ RB committee or backup lead; Wilson target bump possible.
items.opportunity: Carries and snaps to backups; Garrett Wilson may see more checkdowns.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.implication: Depth/possible rotational WR with Lamar out.
items.opportunity: Potential snap share in BAL WR room.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense nightmare for pass catchers.
items.opportunity: High target share vs weak pass D.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI as WR6; bankable usage.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI as RB5; elite recent usage vs run-leaking D.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA as WR28; ugly matchup and QB situation.
items.why: Tough SEA defense and shaky QB play.
